name: calc
description: Exact arithmetic. Use it for every sum, percentage, margin or total instead of working numbers out yourself.

name: shop_summary
description: Sales, count of sales and expenses for a period of this shop.

name: find_product
description: Look up products by name: price, cost and stock.

name: low_stock
description: Products running low or out of stock.

name: customers_owing
description: Customers who owe money, largest first.

name: recall_memory
description: Search the notes this shop owner asked Pesa to remember.

name: remember
description: Save a short note the owner asked you to remember. Only when the owner clearly asks. The owner can see and delete notes.

name: analyze_csv
description: Column totals, averages, minimums and maximums for the CSV or spreadsheet text the owner attached.

name: sales_by_period
description: Sales total, number of sales, average sale and profit estimate for a period.

name: top_products
description: Best selling products by quantity for a period.

name: sales_by_staff
description: Sales per staff member for a period.

name: payment_methods
description: Sales split by cash, card, wallet and credit for a period.

name: stock_value
description: Value of all stock at cost and at selling price.

name: stock_variances
description: Expected stock against counted stock, in units, cost and cash value.

name: out_of_stock
description: Products that are out of stock.

name: slow_movers
description: Products in stock that did not sell in the last 30 days.

name: supplier_balances
description: What the shop still owes each supplier.

name: supplier_reconciliation
description: Supplier checks: statement difference, goods not invoiced, price differences.

name: reconciliation_status
description: Overall reconciliation status this month: stock, suppliers, cash and expenses.

name: customer_history
description: One customer: balance owed, number of purchases, total bought, last purchase.

name: expenses_summary
description: Expenses total and biggest categories for a period.

name: till_status
description: The open till: cash, card, wallet and credit taken so far.

name: refunds_summary
description: Refunds and voided sales for a period.

name: vat_summary
description: VAT collected, VAT paid and net VAT for a period. A record, not tax advice.

name: profit_and_loss
description: Profit and loss from the books: revenue, cost of sales, expenses, net result.

name: forecast
description: Estimated sales for the next 7 days.

name: compare_periods
description: Sales this period against the one before.

name: unusual_days
description: Days with unusually high or low sales.

name: alerts_and_notes
description: Recent notes and warnings from the Pesa assistant. They are signs to check, not proof.
